Finding us, and when to come

Three things worth knowing before you walk down the steps.

The address

Tbilisi Old Town, Tbilisi

We sit in the lanes of the Old Town, a short walk from the sulphur baths, behind a low oak door and down a flight of stone steps. Look for the copper lantern above the entrance rather than a sign.

Hours at the table

Lunch through late evening, seven days a week

The tone oven is lit before the first guests arrive and the kitchen stays open until the last plate leaves it. Evenings fill first, so early tables are the quieter ones.

Walk in or reserve

Walk-ins welcome, larger tables by arrangement

Two or three guests can usually be seated as they arrive. For a long table, a supra with many courses, or a particular corner of the cellar, write to us beforehand.
